Name: Anime Catboy Sprite Mod
Author: MousyModder
Description:
[center][font=Courier New]﻿> Hi there! …So this mod is actually not my original idea, so all credit goes to Gigi and her lovely [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759]Portrait Mod[/url], 채칼's [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/PostView.nhn?blogId=mycho621&logNo=220739941625&targetKeyword=&targetRecommendatijavascript-event-stripped1=undefined]Alternate Wizard Sprite[/url]﻿, as well as finnsinn's edit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5487]Make them Catboys[/url]!
[size=1](I will 100% take this mod down if any of them have any issues with this mod being published.)[/size]

> This mod only changes the vanilla sprites to look a bit more like those two mods for immersion purposes, so this mod may look a little odd without the other two, so please check them out!﻿﻿
[/font][/center][center][font=Courier New]﻿> To install, simply extract the zip file into your mods folder (Stardew Valley/Mods) and make sure you have the current version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿!

> This mod may not be compatible with other sprite editing mods centered around Alex, Sam, Shane, Sebastian and the Wizard, so proceed with caution![/font][/center]

Manifest.Description: Sprites that match finnsinn's edit of gigi's portrait mod for added immersion
